input_object: ow_tp.silver.custbill_records WHERE ns=? — ALL rows for the namespace, no date window (legacy aggregates every parsed/*.psv ever written). Fixture seed: `python3 scripts/tp_dbx/custbill.py seed-fixture --layer silver --ns <ns> --legacy-root <root>`.
golden_baseline_location: Regenerated: full legacy chain `make legacy-etl-run JOB=run_all` (RUN_ALL_SLEEP=0) under `OTTERWORKS_LEGACY_ROOT=/home/ubuntu/otterworks-legacy-<ns>` via scripts/tp-run-deterministic.sh with `TP_FAKETIME='2026-09-01 02:10:00'` so the stamp is 20260901. Baseline = `reports/finance_billing_20260901.csv` (header + 6 rows) and the awk recompute in docs/tech-partnerships/runbook-databricks.md.

declared_source_volume.keys: 3 currencies × 2 record types present in the demo seed

behaviour.aggregation: SELECT currency, CASE rec_type WHEN '01' THEN 'INVOICE' WHEN '02' THEN 'CREDIT' ELSE concat('UNKNOWN(', rec_type, ')') END AS record_type, count(*) AS record_count, sum(bill_amt) AS total_amount (DECIMAL(18,2), exact) FROM silver WHERE ns=? GROUP BY currency, rec_type. Rows with empty cust_id are excluded (legacy `next if $cust eq ""`).
behaviour.ordering: ORDER BY currency, rec_type — identical to Perl `sort keys %tot` on the `ccy|rt` key because currency is fixed 3 chars and `|` sorts below letters/digits in ASCII; assert equality with the legacy CSV order in recon rather than assume.
behaviour.load: INSERT OVERWRITE gold ... WHERE ns=? (replace the namespace's rows only) with report_date = run date (parameter `report_date`, default current_date in UTC) and generated_at.
behaviour.csv_export: Header `Currency,RecordType,RecordCount,TotalAmount` then `%s,%s,%d,%.2f` rows, `\n` line ends, no BOM, no trailing blank line beyond the final newline → byte-identical to legacy.
behaviour.xlsx_export: Real workbook (openpyxl), one sheet `finance_billing`, same header and rows, amounts as numbers with 0.00 format. Replaces the CSV-renamed-to-.xls; the legacy `.xls` is compared to the CSV (T6) not to the workbook.
behaviour.distribution: Job-level e-mail notification (Terraform var finance_recipients, default finance-reports@otterworks.dev) on failure; on success the run log prints the two export paths. No sendmail, no jake@. Delivery to real inboxes is not exercised in the run (D4-1/R2).

encoding_policy.input_encoding: typed silver columns; CSV written as UTF-8 (ASCII on fixtures)
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: CSV bytes must equal the legacy CSV bytes after T6 canonicalisation (none needed on fixtures); currency and record_type strings copied verbatim from silver

malformed_record_policy.details: Silver is typed and never NULL by the parse contract; a NULL bill_amt/currency/rec_type reaching finance is a contract violation and fails the task loudly (legacy silently summed undef as 0). Unknown rec_type values are reported as UNKNOWN(<rt>) exactly like legacy.

empty_input_semantics.details: 0 silver rows for ns → gold rows for ns deleted, CSV with header only, xlsx with header only; task succeeds (legacy wrote a header-only CSV).

planted_anomalies.description: On the 2023 anomaly seed the target totals legitimately differ from the legacy CSV by exactly the quarantined rows; recon must report this as a named, quantified delta (rows and cents) computed from the quarantine table, not as a tolerance.

planted_anomalies.reason: Legacy Perl float sum happens to round correctly on the 100-row seed; no fixture produces a visible drift. DECIMAL(18,2) makes the target exact by construction; recon compares to the cent.

acceptance_checks.description: Gold WHERE ns=?: key set, record_count and total_amount == legacy CSV rows exactly (6 keys on demo seed; T5, T2).
Exported CSV bytes == legacy finance_billing_<stamp>.csv bytes (T6); legacy .xls bytes == legacy .csv bytes (documents the legacy defect).
Independent recompute: awk over the legacy PSV (runbook one-liner) == gold totals to the cent; and sum(total_amount) over gold == sum(bill_amt) over silver for ns.
Idempotency: rerun → identical gold rows, byte-identical CSV; xlsx re-generated with identical cell values (T9; xlsx bytes excluded from parity per T11 because of embedded timestamps).
xlsx opens with openpyxl, sheet finance_billing, header + 6 rows, numeric amounts equal to CSV values.

deficiencies_retired: CSV renamed to .xls → real .xlsx + canonical CSV
sendmail pipe no-op, stale recipients hardcoded → job notification to a managed Terraform list
silently skipped/undef fields → typed input, loud failure
Perl 5.005 no strict → Spark SQL + tested Python export
